feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 12:00am
items.description:
##Today##

Outbreaks of rain becoming persistent and heavy at times during Tuesday and continuing into the night Winds will be a strong to gale force south-easterly decreasing later. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds. Gales in the morning/early afternoon. Coastal overtopping around the times of high tide (~10:30am and ~11pm). Risk of localised flooding due to heavy rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 10°C

SE


##Wind##

Southeast 20-32, soon increasing 25-35 with gusts 38-50, decreasing 25-32 later.


##Visibility##

##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Patchy outbreaks of rain at first soon clearing to become dry and largely cloudy for the rest of the day on Wednesday. Fresh to strong southeast wind becoming a moderate to fresh east or southeast later. Highest temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds until later. Risk of coastal overtopping around high tide (~11:15am and ~11:45pm)

##Thursday, 26 November 2026##

Dry for much of the day on Thursday with variable amounts of cloud. Cloud then thickening later with the risk of a few outbreaks of rain. Southeast wind steadily increasing through the day, top temperature 7°C. Comments: Strong winds soon developing.

Outbreaks of rain through the morning, then becoming dry with some sunny/clear intervals developing through the afternoon. Fresh to strong southeast wind easing and a top temperature of 8°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of heavy rain at first.
